item: Tier-4 #11 blinded benchmark vs existing antigen-ranking methods
question: Does the committed rankscore (frozen weights) discriminate clinically PURSUED CAR-T antigens from unpursued surface proteins better than (a) an expression-only baseline and (b) a published antigen-review catalog?
blinding: outcome labels (clinical pursuit) are NOT an input to any ranker: rankscore weights and its five axes (tumor_signal, normal_safety, protein_breadth, tractability, nonessentiality - verified in results/rankscore_v1.json) contain no trial-derived information; labels are joined only after ranker scores are frozen

outcome_label.primary: positive = verdict 'genuine' (n=20 of 205); all other verdicts negative
outcome_label.sensitivity: exclude ambiguous verdicts (collision n=13, biomarker n=9, mixed n=1) instead of counting them negative

rankers.rankscore: frozen committed weights {tumor_signal 0.3, normal_safety 0.25, protein_breadth 0.15, tractability 0.15, nonessentiality 0.15} applied to all corpus genes; components recomputed per the committed scripts_rankscore.py rules from committed per-gene data
rankers.expression_only: tumor_signal axis alone (the expression window without safety/tractability axes)
rankers.published_catalog: binary membership in the antigen-target list of 'Advancements and challenges in CAR-T cell therapy for solid tumors: A comprehensive review of antigen targets' (PMC12374352); fallback if its tables are not extractable: 'Advances in CAR T cell therapy: antigen selection, modifications, and current trials' (PMC11743624); extracted list committed as an artifact with provenance at analysis time - the list is fixed by the source, not tuned

endpoints: AUROC per ranker on the 205-gene corpus (primary label rule)
primary comparison: AUROC(rankscore) - AUROC(expression_only) with 95% CI by 10,000 bootstrap resamples over genes (seed 20260929)
secondary: catalog-membership Fisher exact test + balanced accuracy; per-axis AUROC table
verdict rule: rankscore declared SUPERIOR TO EXPRESSION-ONLY if the bootstrap CI of the AUROC difference excludes 0 above; otherwise declared NOT DEMONSTRATED, reported as-is
known_gaps: only 20 positives - AUROC CIs will be wide (declared); corpus was assembled FOR this study (selection is documented in the repo; the background class was expression-matched at design time - declared as a mitigant); pursuit labels reflect trial activity, not biological truth (declared)
